bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for an entrepreneur innovation center in the city of Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+NEIGHBORHOOD DEVELOPMENT CENTER. +]

[+$4,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Neighborhood Development Center to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new entrepreneur innovation center located in the Lake Street Corridor in the city of Minneapolis. The new building shall include space for entrepreneurs from low-income communities to develop and operate their businesses, and may include a technology accelerator, a beauty, health, and wellness incubator with a small-batch production kitchen, community event and meeting space, a food production kitchen, and retail space. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for an entrepreneur innovation center in the city of Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. NEIGHBORHOOD DEVELOPMENT CENTER.

$4,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Neighborhood Development Center to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new entrepreneur innovation center located in the Lake Street Corridor in the city of Minneapolis. The new building shall include space for entrepreneurs from low-income communities to develop and operate their businesses, and may include a technology accelerator, a beauty, health, and wellness incubator with a small-batch production kitchen, community event and meeting space, a food production kitchen, and retail space. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $4,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Neighborhood Development Center to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new entrepreneur innovation center located in the Lake Street Corridor in the city of Minneapolis. The new building shall include space for entrepreneurs from low-income communities to develop and operate their businesses, and may include a technology accelerator, a beauty, health, and wellness incubator with a small-batch production kitchen, community event and meeting space, a food production kitchen, and retail space. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
